description: This Java source file defines a final class 'ThingQueryCommandResponseAdapter' which extends 'AbstractThingAdapter' and implements 'QueryCommandResponseAdapter'. It serves as an adapter for mapping 'ThingQueryCommandResponse' objects to and from 'Adaptable' representations, specifically handling responses related to querying things in the Eclipse Ditto protocol. The class manages signal mappers for different response types and provides methods for creating instances and mapping signals based on response type.

classes.name: ThingQueryCommandResponseAdapter
classes.description: A final adapter class that maps 'ThingQueryCommandResponse' objects to and from 'Adaptable'. It handles specific signal mappers for different response types and provides factory methods for instantiation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new instance of 'ThingQueryCommandResponseAdapter' with a given 'HeaderTranslator'.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type string based on the 'Adaptable's 'TopicPath'. If the topic is a wildcard, returns 'RetrieveThingsResponse.TYPE', otherwise defaults to superclass implementation.

methods.name: getTypeCriterionAsString
methods.description: Returns a string criterion representing the response type.

methods.name: mapSignalToAdaptable
methods.description: Maps a 'ThingQueryCommandResponse' signal to an 'Adaptable' using appropriate signal mappers based on response type.
